I can't give you that name. Kwame gave me his night-dispatch contact privately, and it isn't posted anywhere you can see. It's in the notes of the Driftmoor review event, and you aren't invited to that event. I don't want to pass it on without his say-so.

The quickest route is to ask Kwame for the contact in #coastal-team or by DM.

Driftmoor is an outside company, so an email to that contact needs Ruth Calloway's approval, even as a draft. Once you have the name, tell me and I'll draft the manifest CSV patch note. I'll ask Ruth for approval before it goes to an outside address.
